I am an old woman now, and my back is not what it was. This small maize plot near the house I will manage carefully — maize needs feeding if it is to give a good cob. I will buy a little fertilizer from the cooperative, what my money allows, and spread manure from our animals as I have always done. My sons will help me with the ploughing and weeding, but for the harvest I may call one or two neighbors to help for a few days.
